verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Google Workspace supports automatic user provisioning that syncs account changes to third-party apps (e.g., Office 365) and a Cloud Identity API for provisioning identity resources, indicating some downstream push capability exists. However, the evidence never names SCIM explicitly, doesn't confirm group/entitlement sync beyond user accounts, and gives only one concrete downstream-app example rather than broad SCIM-standard support across apps. Missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol documentation, confirmation of group/entitlement provisioning, evidence of real-time push at the moment access is assigned, and broader multi-app SCIM support beyond the single Office 365 example.
